_comment: Veterinary Knowledge Graph v1. Conditions with weighted symptom associations, compiled from public veterinary references. The symptom names used here ARE the official vocabulary for Person 2's symptom detection heads - do not invent new names without updating this file. This layer is PRE-SCREENING support, never a diagnosis.

lumpy_skin_disease.label: Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD)
lumpy_skin_disease.advice_farmer: Firm lumps on the skin can spread to other animals. Keep this animal separate and do not share feed or water troughs.
lumpy_skin_disease.advice_vet: Nodular skin lesions consistent with capripox. Notifiable - isolate, confirm clinically, initiate ring vaccination protocol per state guidelines.

foot_and_mouth_disease.label: Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD)
foot_and_mouth_disease.advice_farmer: Sores in the mouth with heavy drooling spread very fast. Keep the animal away from the herd and inform your veterinary officer today.
foot_and_mouth_disease.advice_vet: Vesicular oral lesions + ptyalism + lameness pattern. Notifiable - restrict movement, report to block veterinary officer, sample per FMD protocol.

mastitis.label: Mastitis
mastitis.advice_farmer: The udder looks swollen or uneven. Milk this animal last, keep the udder clean, and have the milk checked.
mastitis.advice_vet: Visible udder inflammation/asymmetry. Recommend CMT on all quarters, milk culture if available, review milking hygiene.

hoof_lameness.label: Lameness (hoof origin)
hoof_lameness.advice_farmer: The animal is not walking evenly. Check the hooves for stones, cracks or smell, and keep it on soft dry ground.
hoof_lameness.advice_vet: Gait asymmetry with hoof abnormality. Recommend hoof examination and trimming; rule out foot rot / sole ulcer / white line disease.

pinkeye.label: Infectious keratoconjunctivitis (pinkeye)
pinkeye.advice_farmer: The eye looks cloudy or watery. Keep the animal in shade away from dust and flies, and show it to a vet.
pinkeye.advice_vet: Ocular opacity/epiphora pattern. Examine for corneal ulceration; fly control for the herd; early topical treatment prevents blindness.

respiratory_infection.label: Respiratory infection
respiratory_infection.advice_farmer: Runny nose with low energy can be a chest infection. Give clean water, shade and rest, and call the vet if it does not improve in a day.
respiratory_infection.advice_vet: Nasal discharge with depression. Auscultate, check temperature; consider BRD complex, especially with recent transport/weather stress.

ringworm.label: Ringworm (fungal skin infection)
ringworm.advice_farmer: Round grey patches on the skin usually heal but can spread to people and other animals. Avoid touching them with bare hands.
ringworm.advice_vet: Circular alopecic crusted lesions consistent with dermatophytosis. Zoonotic - advise handling hygiene; topical antifungal if extensive.

tick_infestation.label: Tick infestation
tick_infestation.advice_farmer: Ticks drink blood and weaken the animal. Remove visible ticks and ask the vet about spray or pour-on treatment.
tick_infestation.advice_vet: Visible ectoparasite load. Recommend acaricide program and pasture management; monitor for tick-borne disease signs (theileriosis, babesiosis).

bloat.label: Bloat (ruminal tympany)
bloat.advice_farmer: A swollen left side after eating can be dangerous within hours. Walk the animal slowly and call the vet immediately.
bloat.advice_vet: Left flank distension pattern. Time-critical - assess for frothy vs free-gas bloat; stomach tube / trocar per severity.

malnutrition.label: Malnutrition / negative energy balance
malnutrition.advice_farmer: The animal is thinner than it should be. Increase green fodder and ask about mineral mixture; also ask the vet to check for worms.
malnutrition.advice_vet: Low BCS with poor coat. Review ration energy/protein density; recommend fecal egg count and deworming per result.

wound_abscess.label: Wound / abscess
wound_abscess.advice_farmer: There is a visible wound. Clean it with dilute antiseptic and keep flies away; see a vet if it is deep or swollen.
wound_abscess.advice_vet: Visible skin lesion/swelling. Assess depth and infection; debride/drain as indicated; tetanus risk if deep puncture.

general_weakness.label: General weakness / systemic illness
general_weakness.advice_farmer: The animal looks dull and low on energy. Give shade, water and easy feed, and have a vet examine it soon.
general_weakness.advice_vet: Nonspecific depression posture. Broad differential - recommend full clinical exam including temperature, mucous membranes, rumen motility.
